validation: Full Go normal/race/checkptr suites; final changed-package normal/race/checkptr checks.
amd64 cross-compilation; arm64 SIMD-enabled parser/plan/API checks.
All completed engine fingerprints match; baseline cancellations remain recorded separately.
limitations: Synthetic warm-cache workloads, not weighted production scores.
peGosus Prepare excluded, DuckDB per-execution planning and Polars collect optimization included.
DuckDB Python-row conversion included; Polars retained-table projection can share columns.
Memory budgets limit requested query payload, not physical process memory. Bulk sort state moved from Go heap into reusable slabs; retained capacity is separately reported.
Cross-engine ranking uses two rounds/ten samples. Paired variants use two rounds/six samples and explicit query order; baseline cancellations have no ranked timing.
37-query smoke checks use one execution/round for validation and are not used for performance claims.
Initial tiny-case matrix samples overlapped a short normal-test run; million-row, retained-table, paired, memory, and smoke measurements ran independently of correctness suites.

Column diagnostics use one worker and immediate batch release, include footer parsing, and differ from public materializing query profiles. Their early samples overlapped a separate single-worker profiling run; a separate steady public profile was then run alone.
Later runner-only CPU profiling/argument validation edits do not change query definitions or ordinary timing loops. Raw reports retain historical runner source hashes and binaries are fingerprinted.
